title: UbuntuGuard agent_settings policy payload, version 1
description: Server-side tunables. Every field is optional: an omitted field keeps the compiled default. The bounds are enforced in two deliberately different ways. The SERVER validates against this schema at policy-creation time and REJECTS an out-of-range value, so an admin gets immediate feedback. The AGENT validates the payload strictly for structure but treats ranges leniently and CLAMPS to its own compiled constants, emitting a settings_clamped event with the requested and applied values; an agent must never brick itself because a newer server sent a value it considers out of range. The Go constants are the runtime authority. Security invariants (HTTPS-only, signature-before-parse, 300 s clock-skew tolerance, 50 % certificate renewal) are absent from this schema because they are not configurable at all.

heartbeat_jitter_pct.description: Random spread applied to each interval so a fleet of 50 devices does not arrive in lockstep.

backoff_max_seconds.description: Ceiling for exponential backoff with full jitter. A network-up or resume-from-sleep event cancels the current wait instead of serving it out.

event_queue_max_events.description: Durable SQLite queue cap. On overflow the oldest events are dropped and a single queue_overflow event records how many were lost, so the gap is visible rather than silent.

log_level.description: debug raises verbosity only. No level ever logs tokens, keys, certificates or signature values.
